Subject: Follow-up: Post-demo security checklist, red-team report & vuln handling

Hi Aisha / Devon — thanks again for the demo earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side: 

- Redwood readiness: we support SOC 2 Type II in-scope controls for production endpoints and maintain audit logs; we also have HIPAA-safe deployments (Private mode + customer KMS).
- From the call it sounds like your security team wants: (1) vendor security questionnaire filled, (2) example pen/red-team report or summary, and (3) clarity on our vuln disclosure and remediation SLAs + scan cadence.

Action items we propose now:
1) We'll attach a vendor questionnaire template (see attachment) and our vulnerability disclosure policy. Lauren (security) will follow up with technical Qs and proposed SLA/cadence.
2) If helpful, we can provide a redacted red-team summary and an outline of remediation timelines (we typically redact customer-identifying detail).
3) Marissa will coordinate CSM/POC logistics and align on access windows for authenticated scans.

Can you confirm the CardioTech contact for the questionnaire and whether you need an NDA/DocuSign before sharing internal scope?

Thanks — speak soon.

— Karthik

Subject: Re: Follow-up: Post-demo security checklist, red-team report & vuln handling

Hi Devon / Aisha — looping in technical details from our security team. Long version below, TL;DR at the top.

TL;DR:
- We can provide a redacted red-team/pen test report (exec summary + technical appendix) and a remediation timeline.
- Proposed vuln remediation SLA: initial triage within 7 business days, full remediation plan within 30 calendar days, and final remediation confirmation within 90 calendar days for typical severity range.
- Scan cadence we recommend: weekly authenticated scans (staging), monthly unauthenticated external scans, and annual 3rd-party pen test.
- Responsible disclosure: we follow a coordinated disclosure process and will share CVE-level details with customers once triage is complete; we can agree on blackout windows.

Details / answers to your Qs:
1) Report redaction: we remove customer PII and internal IP mappings. The redacted report will retain:
   - vulnerability description (vuln class, affected component)
   - reproduction steps at a technical level (no internal IPs or usernames)
   - CVSS or internal severity mapping and suggested remediation
   - artifact samples (sanitized)

2) SLA & disclosure flow:
   - Triage (7 business days): confirm reproducibility and scope.
   - Hotfix / mitigation path (30 days): produce a patch or mitigation plan for high/critical issues.
   - Remediation confirmation (90 days): customer and Redwood confirm fix and closure. If remediation requires vendor patching across multiple stacks, we'll coordinate extensions with approvals.
   - We require coordinated disclosure; public advisories are only published after mutual agreement or if there's an imminent public risk.

3) Scanning cadence / access:
   - Authenticated scans: weekly against staging (credentials via temporary token we rotate).
   - External scans: monthly from third-party scanners.
   - Red-team: annual or on-demand; we can expedite for higher-risk integrations.

4) Deliverables we can share now (attachments): vendor questionnaire (filled template), our vulnerability disclosure policy, and a starter scan-scope worksheet.

Please confirm: whether CardioTech requires the SOC 2 Type II report or a bridge letter (we can route the compliance pack once we have an NDA/DocuSign). Also confirm preferred blackout windows for scans (days/times).

Regards,
Lauren Bishop
Senior Security Manager, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com
From: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@cardiotech.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Fri, 17 Jul 2026 07:54:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Post-demo security checklist, red-team report & vuln handling

Lauren / Karthik — thanks for the clear breakdown. A few items from procurement and security: 

- Procurement: we'll send a DocuSign NDA today (linked below) so you can share the SOC 2 bridge letter and a redacted pen summary.
- Security: 90-day SLA is acceptable; can you confirm whether you allow privileged access for authenticated scans (we typically provide service account creds scoped to non-prod/staging)? If yes, what's the rotation method and audit trail?
- For the redacted report: we need enough detail to validate the attack vector and confirm remediation; please ensure reproduction steps are actionable without internal IPs.

I'll review the attached questionnaire and aim to return it within 3 business days. Once NDA is signed we'll expect the compliance pack and redacted summary.

Thanks,
Aisha Patel
Head of Procurement, CardioTech Inc
aisha.patel@cardiotech.com

Date: Fri, 17 Jul 2026 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Post-demo security checklist, red-team report & vuln handling

Aisha — great, appreciate the fast turnaround. We'll look out for the NDA DocuSign and will prepare the compliance pack + redacted pen summary to share as soon as it's executed. 

Quick answers to your immediate questions: 
- Privileged access for authenticated scans: yes, we accept scoped service accounts for staging only; credentials are rotated via our secrets manager and we provide audit logs for all scan sessions.
- Rotation: short-lived tokens (default 24 hours) and we can extend/shorten on a per-customer basis.

I'll assign Marissa to coordinate the DocuSign return and schedule a 30-minute technical sync with Devon and Lauren next week to agree scan windows. Proposed slot: Tue 21 Jul, 10:00–10:30 PT — does that work?

Regards,
Karthik
